title: Making requests: getMe
means: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME. Like this for example: https://api.telegram.org/bot123456:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl-zyx57W2v1u123ew11/getMe We support GET and POST HTTP methods.

title: Making requests: methods are case-insensitive
means: All methods in the Bot API are case-insensitive.

title: getUpdates: limit
means: Limits the number of updates to be retrieved. Values between 1-100 are accepted. Defaults to 100.

title: getUpdates: a negative offset
means: The negative offset can be specified to retrieve updates starting from -offset update from the end of the updates queue. All previous updates will be forgotten.

title: getUpdates: allowed_updates and the updates made before
means: Please note that this parameter doesn't affect updates created before the call to getUpdates, so unwanted updates may be received for a short period of time.

title: deleteWebhook: drop pending updates
means: Pass True to drop all pending updates

title: sendChatAction: an action
means: Type of action to broadcast. Choose one, depending on what the user is about to receive: typing for text messages , upload_photo for photos , record_video or upload_video for videos , record_voice or upload_voice for voice notes , upload_document for general files , choose_sticker for stickers , find_location for location data , record_video_note or upload_video_note for video notes .

title: deleteMessage: an incoming message in a private chat
means: Bots can delete incoming messages in private chats.

title: deleteMessage: 48 hours
means: A message can only be deleted if it was sent less than 48 hours ago.

title: deleteMessage: a channel's creation
means: Service messages about a supergroup, channel, or forum topic creation can't be deleted.

title: deleteMessage: an administrator of a group
means: If the bot is an administrator of a group, it can delete any message there.

title: deleteMessage: outgoing in a group
means: Bots can delete outgoing messages in private chats, groups, and supergroups.

title: sendMediaGroup: documents with their own type only
means: Documents and audio files can be only grouped in an album with messages of the same type.

title: sendPhoto: width and height ratio
means: The photo's width and height must not exceed 10000 in total. Width and height ratio must be at most 20.

title: sendPhoto: 10 MB
means: The photo must be at most 10 MB in size.

title: sendVideo: 50 MB
means: Bots can currently send video files of up to 50 MB in size, this limit may be changed in the future.

title: sendDocument: 50 MB
means: Bots can currently send files of any type of up to 50 MB in size, this limit may be changed in the future.

title: MarkdownV2 style: reserved characters
means: In all other places characters '_', '*', '[', ']', '(', ')', '~', '`', '>', '#', '+', '-', '=', '|', '{', '}', '.', '!' must be escaped with the preceding character '\'.

title: MarkdownV2 style: italic and underline
means: In case of ambiguity between italic and underline entities __ is always greedily treated from left to right as beginning or end of an underline entity, so instead of ___italic underline___ use ___italic underline_**__ , adding an empty bold entity as a separator.

title: MarkdownV2 style: the expandability mark
means: The last line of the expandable block quotation with the expandability mark||

title: Markdown style: escaping
means: Escaping inside entities is not allowed, so entity must be closed first and reopened again: use _snake_\__case_ for italic snake_case and *2*\**2=4* for bold 2*2=4 .

title: Formatting options: a mention by id
means: Links tg://user?id=<user_id> can be used to mention a user by their identifier without using a username.

title: sendPhoto: a file Telegram cannot process as an image
means: IMAGE_PROCESS_FAILED Failure while processing image.

title: sendMessage: a channel's username
means: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup or channel in the format @username

title: ReplyParameters: sent without the message replied to
means: Pass True if the message should be sent even if the specified message to be replied to is not found.

title: sendPhoto: a file_id
means: Pass a file_id as String to send a photo that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended)

title: sendPhoto: an HTTP URL
means: pass an HTTP URL as a String for Telegram to get a photo from the Internet

title: Sending files: a file_id is one bot's
means: file_id is unique for each individual bot and can't be transferred from one bot to another.

title: Sending files: a file keeps its type
means: It is not possible to change the file type when resending by file_id . I.e. a video can't be sent as a photo , a photo can't be sent as a document , etc.

title: ChatMemberAdministrator: posting in a channel
means: Optional . True , if the administrator can post messages in the channel, approve suggested posts, or access channel statistics; for channels only

title: ChatMemberBanned: a banned bot
means: Represents a chat member that was banned in the chat and can't return to the chat or view chat messages.

title: ChatMemberLeft: a bot not in a channel
means: Represents a chat member that isn't currently a member of the chat, but may join it themselves.

title: getFile: 20 MB
means: For the moment, bots can download files of up to 20MB in size.
